title_suffix: workspace scope gate for classic changes
summary: OSpec 1.9.5 brings the Goal-style workspace protection to the classic change workflow: closeout now blocks on uncommitted files that do not belong to the change, so a concurrent session's edits can no longer ride along into an archive.
new: Classic closeout (verify, finalize, and archive --check) runs a workspace scope check: every uncommitted file must belong to the change container, managed OSpec bookkeeping, or the proposal-declared affects/documentation scopes, and unattributed dirty files block closeout with the offending paths listed.
ospec change warns at creation time when the worktree already carries unrelated uncommitted changes, surfacing another session's leftovers before implementation starts.
improved: An empty affects declaration combined with unattributed dirty files blocks closeout with a declare-affects hint instead of passing silently, so the scope contract cannot be skipped by leaving affects empty.
Non-Git directories skip the workspace scope check, keeping non-Git projects and test fixtures unaffected.
docs: The change protocol in all four languages and the ospec-change skill now state the serial-worktree contract: commit, stash, or isolate unattributed work instead of archiving over it.
